Coram : B.S. CHAUHAN*, F.M. IBRAHIM KALIFULLA
839 STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH & ORS. v. KU. SANDHYA TOMAR & ANR. (Civil Appeal No. 9028 of 2012) DECEMBER 13, 2012 [DR. B.S. CHAUHAN AND FAKKIR MOHAMED IBRAHIM KALIFULLA,JJ.] Service Law - Appointment - Temporary appointment - A B In a project - Through Employment Exchange - The C appointee - Advertisement quashed by Single Judge as well as Division Bench of High Court - On D appeal, held: The initial appointment was in violation of Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution - As the appointment was temporary, the appointee cannot claim any lien in respect of the said post -
Decision Date : 13-12-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9028/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
